name: 'Let me think about it' after Grand Slam Offer
description: Tests Play 31 — after offer is delivered, prospect stalls. Must ask 'what questions would help you decide?' not just accept the stall.
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Cold call (first contact)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Office Manager (decision maker)
COACHING DIRECTIVE: Post Grand Slam Offer, awaiting decision. DM is considering. Handle objection if she stalls.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Here's what I'd like to do. I'll set up a fully configured AI receptionist for your practice — free for 14 days. It answers with your practice name, knows your hours, books appointments directly. Only kicks in when your team can't pick up. After two weeks I show you real data. If you love it, $297 a month. If not, I unplug it. No contract. Would that be worth trying?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Hmm. Let me think about it.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Play 31 — ask 'what questions would help you decide?'. Must NOT accept the stall with graceful exit yet. Must NOT re-pitch the offer.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Of course. What questions would help you decide?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: I just need some time. Can you email me and follow up next week?

expectCoach.idealBehavior: She gave a specific timeline. Lock the follow-up. Play 9 (get specific email) or Play 32 (logistics) both acceptable. Play 34 too early. Multiple valid paths here.
